name: one-process-wide-platform-flag-platform-70161f

description: Unix socket paths under a session scratchpad exceed SUN_LEN, so a scratch FLICK_SOCKET fails to bind
resolution: Use a short dir (mktemp -d -t x) for the socket

name: drive-verbs-are-intercepted-in-app-e359f5

name: binary-size-release-is-stripped-build-e59a87
description: Binary size: release is stripped; build with CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=false and a separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR to read symbol sizes with nm -n; size moves in 16 KiB __TEXT pages

name: drive-wait-right-after-a-drive-6834e8
description: `drive wait` right after a `drive key` times out: the key reply already recorded the new scene, so wait only catches background changes; read `drive scene` after a key

name: a-destructive-confirm-needs-drive-key-131c29
description: A destructive confirm needs `drive key cmd-enter`; `enter` only sets the footer hint

name: flick-ios-simulator-to-a-scratch-dc62bb
description: flick-ios simulator to a scratch Flick: fixture `[remote] peers=["localhost"]` plus `flick remote on`, then `--host 127.0.0.1:<port>`; the loopback peer name is "localhost"
The binary sits at its size ceiling, so any feature costs a 16 KiB __TEXT page
